about: Record kind for dungeons injected into the leveling route. Each run: pick-ups as `when dungeon` steps after (or before) an anchored route goal; `runStop`: the pick-ups repeated at the run's own stop (the cheap, local catch-up for a player who opts in after the earlier pick-ups); the run step after `run.after`, guarded by `when dungeon` + `when onquest <run.objectives>`; each hand-in as a `when dungeon` + `when complete`/`when onquest` step after its anchor (every step of a run is behind `when dungeon`, so a character who skips it keeps the solo route's steps and numbers); `soloWay`: a solo step of a stop the run shares, behind `when !dungeon`; `budget`: the measured cost vs the solo route (flow audit dynamic + level model). A Forge writer rule or a check reproduces the hand edits from these. Gates (Fitz, 2026-11-13: never a dungeon too low): `run.gate` is the `when level>=` the run step carries, the dungeon's floor in the Codex (data/forever/codex/journal.json: the client's Group Finder minimum, its fixed minimum or players' recorded entry level, whichever is highest; forge guide lint errors on a run gated under it); a pick-up's `gate` is that floor less the levels the calibrated level model plans between the pick-up and the run (forge judge doors --levels checks it), so a player on pace is asked and one far behind is not; a `runStop` pick-up carries the run's gate. The travel steps of a branch that leaves the solo route's way (the runner's trip out to the door and back) carry the run's gate too, and a runner's step that shares a goal with a `soloWay` step keeps that goal in an ungated step of its own, so a runner under the gate still has it. `checks`: the facts a run's steps rest on that wait for an in-game check (`status` `needs-ingame`; `at` the step, `pickup`, `run` or `handin`; `quest` where it is one quest's; `what` to look at).

notInRoute.why: Left out of the route on purpose: for the Alliance its quests' city stops cost a ~1,450 yd walk from Ironforge's gate and back, and the Horde's Rig Wars is a hand-in waiting a whole guide; its Dungeons page has the pick-up and hand-in guides.

No quest of the dungeon itself can be taken on a stop the route makes in its window: Krom Stoutarm, Prospector Stormpike and Talvash del Kissel are in Ironforge, which the route visits at 30-33 (below their level, Reclaimed Treasures 10 over) and again at 50; the quests the Badlands visits meet (A Sign of Hope and Amulet of Secrets, Solution to Doom, Power Stones, the reagent runs, Agmond's Fate) are done in the outer caves and at the Maker's Terrace, outside the dungeon, where Solution to Doom already is a group quest. A run would have no quest to guard it.

The route's Badlands visits are at 39-40 (30-40/06) and 51-53 (50-60/01's Kargath stops, above the dungeon's quests); Dran Droffers' necklace chain is offered in Orgrimmar at 43-45, after the only Badlands visit in its window, and Patrick Garrett's Reclaimed Treasures is 3+ levels over on the Undercity stop at ~38.

The dungeon's quests the route meets (Maxwort Uberglint's, Oralius', Jalinda Sprig's and Marshal Maxwell's) are offered in the Burning Steppes at 50-53, where the route stays at Morgan's Vigil and Flame Crest, 1,728 and 1,084 yd from the mountain's gate; the route passes the mountain only in the Searing Gorge at 48-49, before any of them is offered.

No giver on a stop the route makes in its window (Mebok in Ratchet, Falfindel in Feralas, Veyric Thunderhame in the Arathi Highlands are off the route then); the nearest point the route passes in the window is 1,041 yd from the door (30-40/03-ashenvale's way into the Barrens).

The route never enters the Wetlands in the dungeon's window; its one giver on the route, Zaruk in Hammerfall (Dragonmaw Rumors, 30-33), sends you 2,956 yd across the Thandol Span to the dig and its other givers are off the route; the route crosses the Wetlands only on 30-40/06's walk from Faldir's Cove at 39-40, 11 levels above the dungeon.
The route never enters Tirisfal Glades.

The route's Tirisfal points are the Undercity and its zeppelin tower (1,244 yd from the door) at ~33 (30-40/01's end) and ~39 (30-40/05's start). At 33 no Scarlet Monastery quest is in reach: Varimathras' Into the Scarlet Monastery is 42, and Test of Lore and Compendium of the Fallen start off the route; at 39 Into the Scarlet Monastery is 3 levels over, and Faranell's Hearts of Zeal (33) comes only for a Razorfen Kraul runner.
No route visit in its window (35-41): the nearest point is 1,048 yd away at 32-33, and its givers are off the route or inside.
No route visit in its window (35-41): the nearest point in it is about 4 km away; its givers are off the route or inside, Varimathras' An Unholy Alliance starts from an item inside.

The route's Desolace visit (38-39) passes 347 yd from the door but below the quests' minimum levels (39 to 45): Willow's Twisted Evils needs 41, Archmage Tervosh's Shadowshard Fragments is offered at 40-43 in Theramore, the others are off the route.

The route is in Desolace only at 32-34, below the dungeon (the Group Finder's 46-55); its 43-47 Feralas visits are a Desolace crossing (about 2 km) from the door, and Uthel'nay's Shadowshard Fragments is in Orgrimmar.
The route passes the temple at 40-43, below its quests (level 50-53, minimum 41-50), and does not come back to the Swamp of Sorrows later.
Its givers on the route are Loremaster Dibbs in Southshore at 30-33 (level 40, 7 over) and Krazek's two quests, which give no experience.
